notes: inference.py auto-selects CUDA / Apple MPS / CPU, so the normal way to run it is locally with the command above; only training needs a dedicated GPU. The 'options' block below is what run.py uses when this script is launched through the workspace launcher as a Hugging Face Job instead.

available_options_reference.timeout: max duration: int with s (default), m, h or d suffix; unset -> API default
available_options_reference.detach: true: submit and return the job id; false: stream job logs after submitting
available_options_reference.script_args: list of CLI arguments passed to the script
available_options_reference.name: job name label (need not be unique)
available_options_reference.secrets: list; 'KEY=VALUE' sets an explicit value, a bare 'KEY' forwards the logged-in HF token
available_options_reference.volumes: hf://[TYPE/]SOURCE:/MOUNT_PATH[:ro|:rw] or LOCAL_DIR:/MOUNT_PATH; TYPE in models|datasets|spaces|buckets
available_options_reference.image: custom Docker image with uv installed
available_options_reference.namespace: namespace to run the job in (unset -> current user)
available_options_reference.with: extra packages to install (maps to run_uv_job dependencies)
available_options_reference.python: interpreter version for the run environment
